item.tib: rgyal chen shel khrab can gyi ka bstod
item.coloph: ces pa'i rgyal chen shel khrab can gyi ka bstod snyan 'jib ('jebs) ku khu'i sgra dbyangs 'di yang kang ka'i rigs grol g.yung drung thogs med kyis gong ma'i gdan sa shar grol smin gling gi lho ngos rab gsal nyi 'od bsam gtan khang bzang du 'phral du bris pa 'dis kyang / bstan dgra rtsad nas chod par gyur cig/
